title: Employee Lifecycle Management
content: Manage employee records from onboarding to exit with a centralized database that is secure, organized, and easy to access.

title: Payroll Management
content: Accurate and timely payroll processing with automated salary calculations, payslips, reimbursements, and deductions.

title: Attendance & Leave Management
content: Track attendance, shifts, overtime, and leave balances with automated approvals and reports.

title: Performance Management System (PMS)
content: Set goals, track performance, conduct appraisals, and generate performance reports to drive productivity.

title: Statutory Compliance Automation
content: Built-in compliance for PF, ESI, PT, TDS, and other statutory requirements to avoid penalties and errors.

title: Employee Self-Service (ESS)
content: Employees can view payslips, apply for leave, update personal details, and access HR policies anytime, anywhere
